blocks.text: MALAYBALAY CITY, Bukidnon — Thirteen fugitives facing serious criminal charges in Mindanao were arrested in police operations conducted from Nov. 15 to 18. The coordinated operations involved city and municipal police stations, the Bukidnon Police Provincial Office, regional mobile forces, and intelligence units, resulting in the capture of several high-profile fugitives on the province’s most wanted list. Among those arrested was Andy Inda of Barangay Lumbo, Valencia City, who was listed as Sumilao’s Top 1 Most Wanted Person (MPS).
